full_prompt_en: A square graphic anime image overlaps two adult male faces in very close framing. The larger face at left is cropped by the side and top edges. A dark blue brimmed cap with gold circular studs casts a sharp shadow across his brow. One intensely blue eye looks outward; the nose, set mouth, and angular jaw are modeled with heavy purple and cream planes. A small gold stud and pale curling hair sit by the ear. Behind him at right, a second similarly capped man is visible from eye level to the upper chest. His blue eyes look forward beneath a dark brim, and his face is covered in violet shadow with pale highlights on the nose, lips, and cheekbones. A gold band and an emblem resembling an upright hand decorate his cap. Both wear high-collared dark blue outer garments with gold fasteners. They do not touch or move; their overlapping heads create a compact hierarchy of foreground and background. The space behind the right figure is a flat hot orange field, visible in a narrow wedge. Thick dark contour lines and short ink hatching emphasize the brow ridges, cheek planes, neck, and clothing folds. Color is boldly non-naturalistic: lavender and deep purple skin shadows meet cobalt-blue caps, cream light, black linework, and orange. The foreground brim forms a strong diagonal from upper left toward the center, directing the gaze across both pairs of eyes. Cropping leaves no setting or complete bodies. There is no readable text. The image has a dramatic, confrontational poster feel, with elaborate face geometry and a close camera distance making stillness feel powerful.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形图形化动漫图像以极近取景叠放两位成年男子的脸。左边较大的脸被侧边和顶边裁去。带金色圆扣的深蓝有檐帽把锋利阴影压在眉上。一只强烈蓝眼向外看；鼻、紧闭的嘴与棱角下颌由厚重紫与奶油色平面造型。耳边有小金耳钉与浅色卷发。其后右侧，第二位同样戴帽的男子从眼部到上胸可见。蓝眼从深檐下向前望，脸覆紫罗兰暗影，鼻、唇和颧骨上有浅亮高光。帽上有金带与像竖起手掌的徽记。两人都穿高领深蓝外衣，配金色扣件。他们没有接触或动作；重叠头部建立紧凑的前后层级。右侧人物后仅有一楔形平坦炽橙背景。厚重深轮廓与短促墨排线强调眉弓、脸颊平面、脖颈和衣褶。色彩大胆地偏离自然：淡紫与深紫肤影碰上钴蓝帽、奶油色光、黑线与橙色。前方帽檐从左上向中央构成强对角，牵引视线经过两对眼睛。裁切不留场景或完整身体。没有可读文字。画面像戏剧性对峙海报，复杂面部几何和靠近的镜头让静止显得有力。
style_prompt_en: The bold action-manga finish uses heavy black contours, short hatch clusters, and angular planes of non-naturalistic color. Cobalt and navy masses meet violet and lavender shadows, cream highlights, small gold fittings, and a hot orange accent field. Extremely close cropping stacks two focal shapes, so one large diagonal brimlike band drives the eye toward multiple bright blue points. Facial geometry is exaggerated and sculptural, with pronounced brows, sharp noses, and hard jaw shadows. The background stays flat and sparse, giving the layered forms graphic force. Line weight varies from thick outer edges to fine texture in recesses. The result is theatrical, intense, and highly controlled, with tension coming from stare, scale overlap, and value contrast.
style_prompt_zh: 醒目的动作漫画完成度使用厚黑轮廓、短排线群和棱角化的非自然色平面。钴蓝与海蓝团块碰上紫罗兰和淡紫阴影、奶油色高光、少数金色扣件和炽橙背景重音。极近裁切层叠两处焦点形状，一条大斜檐般色带把视线引向多处亮蓝点。造型夸张而具雕塑感，眉弓突出，鼻锋利，下颌暗影坚硬。背景平坦稀少，让叠放形体产生图形力量。线宽从厚外缘变化到凹处细纹。结果舞台性、强烈而受控，张力来自凝视、尺度重叠与明度对照。
theme_en: Two severe blue-eyed anime men in brimmed caps overlap against a hot orange ground
theme_zh: 两位蓝眼、戴檐帽的严肃动漫男子在炽橙背景前重叠
name: JoJos Bizarre Adventure
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
